meta.aciklama:
5 skills to turn Claude into a Ai Motion Studio.

#claude #claudecode #opensource #motiongraphicsdesign

transkript.t: Here are five skills that turn Claude into your video studio.
Claude writes your video as code
and every frame renders to MP4.
Give it a topic and it makes a narrated explainer.
The voice runs on your own computer, no API key.
Hand it a talking head video and it's transcript
and it builds motion graphics timed to every word.
One topic line in, a finished cartoon out.
It lands every cut on the beat
and places a real sound for each moment.
Follow for systems that actually run.
